output.reason: The changelog line [ev-b9e3037ef8b7] and PR 10906 [ev-b270867f3540][ev-b5e4a42ccdec] describe how the ruler's WAL watcher and remote storage handle write notifications. That only matters for rulers that remote-write samples through the WAL, and the PR adds that without `notify` the next read waits for the read ticker. The proposed condition matches any ConfigMap whose "config.yaml" has a `ruler:` line, so it is too broad: it flags rulers that never use WAL remote-write. It also assumes a ConfigMap key the evidence never names. No upstream text names the setting that turns on ruler remote-write or notify, so a correct predicate cannot be written from this evidence.
